text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After our outing,
there was an even more important engagement
scheduled for today:
a reception hosted by the jewelry brand for
which we served as ambassadors.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Are your preparations complete, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yes. By the way, about this brooch...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A brooch left alongside the formal attire,
meant for me...
Judging from the design,
it's hard to imagine
the brand provided it, but—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
A gift.
From me, to you.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
As promised—
I have prepared the adornment most befitting
of you.
I commissioned the brand directly.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It is a silver brooch fashioned after a rose
and a trellis.
I would like you to wear it today.
choice_data_list: Roses and a trellis... Th-Thank yo...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Come, let us head to the venue.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This party draws many prominent figures from
the jewelry world... yet curiously,
I feel none of the tension I did during our
recent unveiling.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sapphire I wore for the debut felt
remarkably heavy... yet today's brooch feels,
if anything, somehow warm.

text_block_list.name: Jewelry World Figure A
text_block_list.text:
It appears Lady Rose's attire is adorned
with pearls here and there.
Truly exquisite craft.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. It complements my rose
most wonderfully.

text_block_list.name: Jewelry World Figure B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so it is as I thought.
Did you choose the knight?
choice_data_list: No, this is my Racewear, so...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I explained that I had specifically
designated this brand,
leaving the pearl selection itself to Lady
Rose's discerning eye...
I felt surprised at myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even before prominent figures of the jewelry
world,
she is managing to entertain them with
surprising ease...
choice_data_list: (Could it be because of the rose o...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. You seem nicely relaxed today,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Your attire suits you admirably.
Keep your head held high and carry on with
such pride.

text_block_list.name: Jewelry World Figure C
text_block_list.text:
You are Rose-san's knight, aren't you?
...My. Is that brooch silver?
Could it be from the brand's latest
collection...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was an item Rose Kingdom had arranged
for me,
but...
with most attendees adorned in jewels,
would it stand out?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: —This is something I designed myself.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I sought that which would best befit my
retainer,
and arrived at this.

text_block_list.name: Jewelry World Figure C
text_block_list.text:
My... is that so?
There are no gems set into it, then...?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Indeed. My retainer is—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Though she is devoted,
modest... and inclined to stay
out of the spotlight――the resolve held in
her heart is unyielding.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
You are like a trellis,
lending support to me as I strive to become
the true king of the Rose Clan.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Hence,
I deliberately chose silver as the
material.
I designed this brooch to evoke the image
of 'roses upon a trellis.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Within my heart rests the 'Rose' I am bound
to support.
And as the 'Trellis' upon which that rose
must lean,
I have taken it as my very emblem.
choice_data_list: (Thanks to this brooch, I can hold...

text_block_list.name: Jewelry World Figure D
text_block_list.text:
I see...
That is truly a brooch of profound design.

text_block_list.name: Jewelry World Figure C
text_block_list.text:
It suits you splendidly,
Sir Knight. You are dearly cherished,
I see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward,
once the industry figures learned the meaning
of the brooch,
they crowded around one after another,
showering us with praise as the night went
on—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Back in the waiting room after the party
concluded.
A deep sigh escaped my lips as I reflected
on the conversation from earlier.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Are you fatigued?
choice_data_list: Lady Rose! No, it's not quite that...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
How ought I express my gratitude for the
brooch?
I searched for words,
yet struggled to find any that felt truly
worthy.
choice_data_list: I will surely live up to what this...
I've received far too generous a gift.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: There is no need for that.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Today,
I was finally able to repay your dedication,
if only in a small measure.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Once again,
you have my gratitude and respect.
And furthermore—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I pray you will continue to support me
henceforth.
—Just like a trellis.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Holding back even at a time like this...?
How like you.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
However, today of all days,
I cannot permit such reservations.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Please, accept this.
I wish to reward you for all you do,
if only once in a while.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Would you mind standing over there for a
moment?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, just as I envisioned.
It suits you wonderfully.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: How reassuring it is, having a 'trellis.'
